findings.summary: The new ContactRecord invariant says private notes are never exported, but the same change makes the export operation and journey step include each contact's private notes, a direct contradiction.
findings.evidence: entity.ContactRecord invariant: "Private notes are never included in an export" vs operation.data.export effect: "Each exported contact includes its private notes" and J.control.export/x4: "Export authorized records of the authenticated owner only, with each contact's private notes"

findings.summary: The export affordance effects were not updated to match the changed operation, so the affordance and the operation it invokes now describe different export contents.
findings.evidence: affordance.ExportControls.export effects: ["Export authorized records of the authenticated owner only"] vs operation.data.export effects now include "Each exported contact includes its private notes"
